result.summary: The page is generally functional and well structured. Only minor issues were found, mainly inconsistent horizontal alignment in the header area, ambiguous promo copy, and slight inconsistency in section-header spacing.

issues.description: The delivery address row and the search field appear visually misaligned with the rest of the content, with the address block ending well before the right edge while the search field extends further, making the header spacing feel inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent horizontal padding or container width for the address row, search bar, category chips, and promotional banner.

issues.description: The promotional banner shows the discount code 'TALLINN3' and mentions 3 free deliveries, but the stated minimum order of €10 is not clearly tied to each free delivery, which may be ambiguous or misleading.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the offer wording, for example '3 free deliveries with code TALLINN3 • €10 minimum per order'.

issues.description: The 'See all' link for the 'Popular right now' section sits close to the bottom nav bar area and its vertical alignment differs from the 'See all' link in the 'Fastest near you' row.
issues.suggestion: Align section headers consistently with equal top and bottom spacing and verify that links remain comfortably tappable.
